decisions: Minutes of the September 3, 2025 board meeting approved as amended.
Standard payment terms in new client contracts revised from Net-45 to Net-30, effective November 1, 2025; Pierre Dubois to update contract templates.

Margaret Holvan to arrange an executive meeting with Polestar Industries leadership by October 20, 2025; Aiyana Park to deliver a client recovery and renewal proposal including a $15,000 service credit by October 10, 2025; service credit authorized subject to CEO approval.
Phase 1 of the Nexlane Solutions platform rollout approved for October 15, 2025; Aiyana Park designated project lead; progress report due at November board meeting.
Caldwell Partners engaged for Director of Business Development executive search; target hire date January 5, 2026; Pierre Dubois to finalize engagement letter and budget allocation.
Next board meeting confirmed for November 5, 2025 at 9:00 AM; all attendees to confirm availability by October 8, 2025.
